lessons_used: Waiting screen info enhancements (wait_info) were helpful, winning 3 tests (+5.0%, +5.7%, +4.1%), though 3 tests showed no clear effect.
Adding new screens (new_screen) can be helpful, winning 2 tests (+15.4%, +6.4%), though 1 hurt performance (-7.7%) and 3 showed no clear effect.
Reordering steps (reorder) showed no clear effect in 1 test and hurt performance in another (-3.8%).
Copy adjustments, layout changes, redesigns, hints, and notifications showed no clear effect across all tests.
Predictions underestimated large wins (e.g., predicting +3.0% vs +15.4% measured for pet preview, and +4.0% vs +6.4% for sound selection).
Predictions were generally too high for changes that showed no clear effect or resulted in a loss (e.g., predicting +15.4% for the quiz screen which measured -7.7%).
